lines.text: On the AMC 10, sixteen right answers can score LESS than fourteen.
lines.caption: On the AMC 10, sixteen right answers can score LESS than fourteen.

lines.text: Sounds wrong? It's all in the scoring.
lines.caption: Sounds wrong? It's all in the scoring.

lines.text: Hi, I'm Vantee. Let's crack the AMC 10 scoring, and plan your test day.
lines.caption: Hi, I'm Vantee. Let's crack the AMC 10 scoring, and plan your test day.

lines.text: The AMC 10 is for students in grade ten or below.
lines.caption: The AMC 10 is for students in grade ten or below.

lines.text: It's held every November, in two versions, the A and the B, on different days.
lines.caption: It's held every November, in two versions, the A and the B, on different days.

lines.text: You may take one A test and one B test. That's two chances.
lines.caption: You may take one A test and one B test. That's two chances.

lines.text: No calculators. The questions start gentle, and get harder as you go.
lines.caption: No calculators. The questions start gentle, and get harder as you go.

lines.text: Twenty-five questions, five choices each, in seventy-five minutes.
lines.caption: Twenty-five questions, five choices each, in seventy-five minutes.

lines.text: That's three minutes per question, on average.
lines.caption: That's three minutes per question, on average.

lines.text: A right answer earns six points. The top score is one hundred fifty.
lines.caption: A right answer earns six points. The top score is one hundred fifty.

lines.text: A wrong answer earns zero.
lines.caption: A wrong answer earns zero.

lines.text: But a blank earns one point five. Leaving it empty pays!
lines.caption: But a blank earns one point five. Leaving it empty pays!

lines.text: Now the puzzle makes sense. Sixteen right is ninety-six points. Nine wrong add nothing.
lines.caption: Now the puzzle makes sense. Sixteen right is ninety-six points. Nine wrong add nothing.

lines.text: Fourteen right is eighty-four. Eleven blanks earn sixteen point five.
lines.caption: Fourteen right is eighty-four. Eleven blanks earn sixteen point five.

lines.text: That's one hundred point five. Fewer right answers, higher score!
lines.caption: That's one hundred point five. Fewer right answers, higher score!

lines.text: Why does one hundred matter?
lines.caption: Why does one hundred matter?

lines.text: Right now, a score of one hundred or more on the AMC 10 qualifies you for the AIME.
lines.caption: Right now, a score of one hundred or more on the AMC 10 qualifies you for the AIME.

lines.text: The AIME is the next round. Fifteen questions in three hours.
lines.caption: The AIME is the next round. Fifteen questions in three hours.

lines.text: Every answer is a whole number, from zero to nine hundred ninety-nine.
lines.caption: Every answer is a whole number, from zero to nine hundred ninety-nine.

lines.text: Fourteen right with no mistakes gets you there. You don't need to finish the test!
lines.caption: Fourteen right with no mistakes gets you there. You don't need to finish the test!

scenes.chapter: To guess or not to guess

lines.text: So when should you guess? Let's do the math.
lines.caption: So when should you guess? Let's do the math.

lines.text: Leaving a question blank is a sure one point five.
lines.caption: Leaving a question blank is a sure one point five.

lines.text: A wild guess is right one time in five. Six points times one fifth is one point two, on average.
lines.caption: A wild guess is right one time in five. Six points times one fifth is one point two, on average.

lines.text: One point two is less than one point five. So a wild guess loses.
lines.caption: One point two is less than one point five. So a wild guess loses.

lines.text: Cross out one choice. Now you're right one time in four.
lines.caption: Cross out one choice. Now you're right one time in four.

lines.text: Six over four is one point five. That's a tie.
lines.caption: Six over four is one point five. That's a tie.

lines.text: Cross out two choices. Now it's one time in three. Six over three is two points. Guessing wins!
lines.caption: Cross out two choices. Now it's one time in three. Six over three is two points. Guessing wins!

lines.text: The rule: if you can rule out two choices, guess. If not, leave it blank.
lines.caption: The rule: if you can rule out two choices, guess. If not, leave it blank.

lines.text: Plan your time. Aim to finish the first ten questions in about twenty minutes.
lines.caption: Plan your time. Aim to finish the first ten questions in about twenty minutes.

lines.text: Accuracy beats speed. A careless slip on an easy question throws away six points.
lines.caption: Accuracy beats speed. A careless slip on an easy question throws away six points.

lines.text: Check your easy answers before you chase the hardest ones.
lines.caption: Check your easy answers before you chase the hardest ones.

lines.text: Read the last few questions too. One of them might be in your strong topic.
lines.caption: Read the last few questions too. One of them might be in your strong topic.

lines.text: Use the answer choices: estimate, check the size, or plug a choice back in.
lines.caption: Use the answer choices: estimate, check the size, or plug a choice back in.

lines.text: Let's try one, AMC 10-style. Add up four copies of two to the tenth.
lines.caption: Let's try one, AMC 10-style. Add up four copies of two to the tenth.

lines.text: Choice A is two to the twelfth. B is two to the fortieth. C is eight to the tenth.
lines.caption: Choice A is two to the twelfth. B is two to the fortieth. C is eight to the tenth.

lines.text: D is four to the fortieth. E is two to the fourteenth.
lines.caption: D is four to the fortieth. E is two to the fourteenth.

lines.text: Check the size first. Two to the tenth is about one thousand, so the sum is about four thousand.
lines.caption: Check the size first. Two to the tenth is about one thousand, so the sum is about four thousand.

lines.text: Two to the fortieth and four to the fortieth are giant. Cross them out.
lines.caption: Two to the fortieth and four to the fortieth are giant. Cross them out.

lines.text: Eight to the tenth is two to the thirtieth. Also giant. Cross it out.
lines.caption: Eight to the tenth is two to the thirtieth. Also giant. Cross it out.

lines.text: Two to the fourteenth is over sixteen thousand. Too big.
lines.caption: Two to the fourteenth is over sixteen thousand. Too big.

lines.text: That leaves two to the twelfth. Let's check it.
lines.caption: That leaves two to the twelfth. Let's check it.

lines.text: Four is two squared. Two squared times two to the tenth is two to the twelfth!
lines.caption: Four is two squared. Two squared times two to the tenth is two to the twelfth!

lines.text: To prepare, work through real past AMC 10 problems, with a seventy-five-minute timer.
lines.caption: To prepare, work through real past AMC 10 problems, with a seventy-five-minute timer.

lines.text: Track your score. Where do your points come from? Where do you lose them?
lines.caption: Track your score. Where do your points come from? Where do you lose them?

lines.text: Review every miss, and learn the big topics: algebra, geometry, counting, and number theory.
lines.caption: Review every miss, and learn the big topics: algebra, geometry, counting, and number theory.

lines.text: Vantee has AMC 10-style videos that walk through every solution and every trap.
lines.caption: Vantee has AMC 10-style videos that walk through every solution and every trap.

lines.text: Remember: six for right, one point five for blank, zero for wrong.
lines.caption: Remember: six for right, one point five for blank, zero for wrong.

lines.text: One hundred gets you to the AIME. Accuracy first, and guess only after you rule out two.
lines.caption: One hundred gets you to the AIME. Accuracy first, and guess only after you rule out two.

lines.text: Good luck on test day. You've got this!
lines.caption: Good luck on test day. You've got this!
